name: Data Scientist - ML Platform
jd: We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to build and deploy machine learning models at scale. Requirements: 4+ years of experience in data science or machine learning engineering. Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn). Experience building and deploying ML pipelines (MLflow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker). Solid understanding of statistical analysis and experimental design (A/B testing). Proficiency in SQL and data warehousing (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift). Experience with NLP or computer vision is a plus. Nice to have: PhD in CS, Statistics, or related field. Experience with LLMs and prompt engineering. Familiarity with Spark and distributed computing.
